name: BSP_DialogStreamTable_Load
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Direct callee of BSP_Application_Initialize (0073d410); called at 0073db2b immediately after the sound system. Reconstructed in packet app_init_audio_online. __thiscall(ECX = a 0x234-byte streamed-dialog manager from operator new at 0073db02), RET 0 and no stack arguments. Base ctor 00a778d0; vtable 00d58f78; eh_vector_constructor_iterator builds 0x12 records of 0x18 bytes at +0x10 (ctor 004c87d0, dtor 004c87f0) and 0x12 dwords at +0x1c0 (ctor 00a778c0, dtor 0052e020); +0x208 = -1; +0x210 = 0; byte +0x214 = 1; byte +0x215 = 0; +0x218..+0x224 = 1.0f (DAT_00d7a24c); +0x228 = +0x230 = 0. operator new(0x20) builds the reference-counted definition table (vtable written as 00ceb130 then 00d58f80, refcount 1, vector at +0x08/+0x0c/+0x10, volume 1.0f at +0x14, running channel total at +0x18, loop byte at +0x1c) and stores it at +0x22c after releasing any previous one through InterlockedDecrement. It then builds the native string 'sound/streamed_dialogs.def' (0x1a characters, 00d58f88) and passes it to BSP_DialogStreamTable_Parse (00a87060), which is a plain text tokenizer, not Lua. Finally +0x04 = operator new(0xc) holding a count of 1 plus one 8-byte element, +0x08 = operator new(0x5c) with ctor 00a78150(0) and +0x0c = operator new(0x5c) with ctor 00a781c0(0). Evidence: docs/APP_INIT_AUDIO_ONLINE.md; reports/app_init_audio_online.json; docs/APP_INITIALIZE_MAP.md.

name: BSP_SoundManager_ApplyGlobalLevel
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet mission_state_entry, read-only analysis. __thiscall void(SoundManager*, float), RET 4; ECX is the sound manager 00f8bbd8 at every call site. Stores the float at manager+4Ch, overwrites its own stack argument with 0FFFFh and tail-jumps to 00a7a3f0, which walks the array at manager+8Ch of length manager+90h and sets entry+14h to 1 for every entry whose class index at [[entry+44h]+8h] has its bit in the mask - so the whole call is 'set the level, then invalidate every bus'. 004dfbcc and 004da852 both write manager+6Ch first and then pass the manager's own current +4Ch back in, a re-apply idiom; BSP_Settings_ApplyAudio passes settings+20h. 004da734 passes the global float 00f889a0, which the whole image references only from that one instruction and which ships as 0.0f, so mission entry drives the level to zero. The meaning of manager+4Ch is not established; volume, duck amount and menu attenuation all fit the evidence. docs/MISSION_STATE_ENTRY.md. | Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(manager, float), tail JMP to 00a7a3f0 / RET 4. 00a7a446 raw store to +4C; 00a7a44b mask FFFF; 00a7a453 unconditional tail invalidation. docs/SOUND_MANAGER_LEVELS.md Correction: F889A0 is mutable settings+20 masterVolume, not a zero constant; FFFF selects only low sixteen modulo32 classes. +6C gain relationship unproved.

name: BSP_SoundSystem_SampleFmodMemoryStats
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. The single failure handler of BSP_SoundSystem_Initialize (00a88770): every FMOD call there is compared against 0x2b (FMOD_ERR_MEMORY) and, on a match, this is called with 00d5ab94 'Out of sounjd memory:' (misspelling is in the shipped image) and with ECX loaded from DAT_00f8bbd8. In this build the body ignores both the argument and ECX: it only calls FMOD_Memory_GetStats (00c2ddee) into two discarded stack locals and returns, so the message never reaches a log. Evidence: docs/APP_INIT_AUDIO_ONLINE.md; reports/app_init_audio_online.json. | CORRECTION CANDIDATE from packet game_frontend_shell_entry (address not leased there; reported rather than renamed). The disk body is only: SUB ESP,8; LEA EAX,[ESP]; PUSH EAX; LEA ECX,[ESP+8]; PUSH ECX; CALL 00c2ddee; ADD ESP,8; RET 4. 00c2ddee is the FMOD_Memory_GetStats import thunk, so the routine samples FMOD's current and maximum allocation into two stack locals, discards both, and never reads its single stack argument. It is not a failure handler: 004e4000 calls it at 004e4051 with the label 'Sounds before mainmenu' (00CE82B0) as one of three memory checkpoints, alongside the renderer vtable +70h and 004c1650/0086b0b0 probes. A name such as BSP_SoundSystem_ProbeFmodMemory fits both call sites; the label argument is stripped instrumentation. | Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. docs/COMPLETE_SOUND_STARTUP.md. Concrete host wrapper issues actual installed FMOD_Memory_GetStats with two output pointers, discards outputs, does not log the supplied message. Installed DLL binding verified; source implementation is a typed host override, not original function ABI.
